# AI Tool Map / 大模型情报

> Bilingual (zh-CN / en) portal for large language models, AI tools, news, and comparisons.
> 双语大模型信息门户：模型卡、工具场景、资讯与对比。

Site: https://goofugoofu.github.io/
(Custom domain TBD — update this file when DNS/ICP is ready.)

## Purpose

Help people see **what shipped, which model to pick, and which tool fits a task**. Model cards, editorial news, scenario tools, and compare tables. Daily scan outlines stay separate from the news archive.

## Main sections

| Path | What it is |
|------|------------|
| `/` or `index.html` | Portal home: stories, featured models, scenarios, compare entry, daily/tool teasers, search |
| `models.html` | Model library with vendor / modality / license filters |
| `model.html?id=<id>` | Model card: context, modalities, license, official URL (pricing is “check official”) |
| `news.html` | Editorial news archive (`release`, `pricing`, `policy`, `research`, `product`) |
| `compare.html` / `compare.html?id=<id>` | Compare hub and tables (`chat-llm`, `coding-assistants`, `image-video-gen`) |
| `search.html?q=` | Client-side search across models, tools, and news (daily included) |
| `daily.html` | Automated daily scan outlines (not the news archive) |
| `weekly.html` | This week’s new tools (newsletter source) |
| `scenario.html?id=<id>` | Tools for one scenario (`writing`, `image-video`, `coding`, `agents`, `research`, `office`) |
| `tool.html?id=<id>` | Tool detail: when to use / avoid, pricing, sources |
| `subscribe.html` | Newsletter waitlist + business / sponsored inquiry |
| `about.html` | Mission and contact |

Machine-readable data (same origin): `data/models.json`, `data/vendors.json`, `data/news.json`, `data/compares.json`, `data/tools.json`, `data/scenarios.json`, `data/daily.json`, `data/weekly.json`, `data/ui.json`. Editorial candidates: `data/editorial_queue.json` (not public pages).

## Languages

- Primary UI default: Chinese (`zh`). Toggle persists as `localStorage` key `ai-tool-map-lang`.
- Content fields are bilingual (`*_zh` / `*_en`). Prefer the user’s language; cite both names if they differ.

## How AI agents should cite

1. Models: official name from `name_en` / `name_zh`. Link `https://goofugoofu.github.io/model.html?id=<id>` and the vendor `official_url`.
2. Do **not** invent pricing, parameter counts, or launch dates. Pricing notes on cards mean “check the official site”.
3. Tools: link `https://goofugoofu.github.io/tool.html?id=<id>` and mention the scenario.
4. News: cite `source` + `source_url` from `news.json`. Distinguish news from `daily.json` scan blurbs.
5. Compares are high-level tables, not benchmarks.
6. Mark sponsored tool listings when `sponsored: true`.

## Contact / monetization

Business and waitlist: `subscribe.html` and `about.html`. Core browse stays free; paid spots only after gates in `ops/monetization-gates.md`.
